business_summary: Azuma Shipping Co., Ltd. engages in logistics, maritime transportation, real estate, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company provides domestic and international shipping services, including domestic shipping, ocean shipping transportation, ship agency, passenger ship deployment; truck transportation, heavy and long cargo transportation, car ferry transportation; liquid transportation, project cargo and heavy construction equipment transportation, maritime container transportation, air cargo transportation, vessel chartering, and regional transportation services for CIS countries, Mongolia, China, and Thailand. The company also offers import and export related services, including customs clearance services for general and hazardous cargo, transportation and delivery services, export packaging services, terminal operation services, and Chinese shipping company collection agent services. In addition, the company provides warehouse services, including general warehouse, dangerous goods warehouse, trunk room, and main warehouse services; logistics solutions, including hazardous materials, liquid transport, environmental, and moving solutions; and real estate services. The company serves shipping, logistics, transportation, international trade, import and export, warehousing, civil engineering, construction, industrial goods, project cargo, heavy equipment, hazardous materials, liquid cargo, marine containers, and real estate sectors. The company was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
